Bagu Mama Children's Books
Math is Here!

summary_zh: 本页为绘本封面，标题为《了解大小多少粗细》，副标题《大大熊和小小兔》，作者钟林姣，绘者曾茜雅，由金盾出版社出版。画面中一只大熊抱着一只小兔，体现大小对比的主题。

title_zh: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔
title_en: Big Bear and Little Rabbit: Learning Sizes and Thickness
source_file: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
大大熊和小小兔是一对邻居，也是好朋友。
大大熊住的是大大的树屋，小小兔住的是小小的蘑菇房。
大大熊每天早上吃一个大大的蜂蜜面包，
小小兔每天早上吃一个小小的胡萝卜蛋糕。
大大熊用大大的杯子喝水，小小兔用小小的杯子喝水。
page_text_en:
Big Bear and Little Rabbit are neighbors and good friends.
Big Bear lives in a big treehouse, and Little Rabbit lives in a small mushroom house.
Big Bear eats a big honey bread every morning,
Little Rabbit eats a small carrot cake every morning.
Big Bear drinks water from a big cup, and Little Rabbit drinks water from a small cup.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了大大熊和小小兔这对邻居好朋友，描述了他们住的房子大小不同，以及早餐和喝水用具的大小对比，通过具体生活场景展现‘大小’的主题。

title_zh: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔
title_en: Big Bear and Little Rabbit: Learning Sizes and Thickness
source_file: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
小小兔伤心的时候，大大熊
会给小小兔一个大大的拥抱。
大大熊伤心的时候，小小兔
会给大大熊一个小小的拥抱。

小小兔的床小小的，
只能放下大大熊的一只脚。
大大熊的床大大的，
可以睡下几十只小小兔。
page_text_en:
When Little Rabbit is sad, Big Bear
will give Little Rabbit a big hug.
When Big Bear is sad, Little Rabbit
will give Big Bear a small hug.

Little Rabbit's bed is small,
fitting only one of Big Bear's feet.
Big Bear's bed is big,
can sleep dozens of Little Rabbits.
summary_zh: 本页通过拥抱和床铺的对比，展现了大大熊和小小兔在情感支持和生活空间上的大小差异，进一步强化了‘大小’的主题。

title_zh: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔
title_en: Big Bear and Little Rabbit: Learning Sizes and Thickness
source_file: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
晚上，大大熊和小小兔会坐在
一起数星星。
有时候，星星很多，一颗星，
两颗星，三颗星……大大熊和小小
兔怎么数也数不清。
有时候，星星很少，少到只剩
下一颗明亮的北极星，大大熊和小
小兔一下就数清了。
听说桃子很好吃，大大熊在门前种了
九棵桃树，小小兔在门前种了两棵桃树。
大大熊种的桃树多，小
小兔种的桃树少。
大大熊给桃树浇水多，
小小兔给桃树浇水少。
大大熊给桃树施肥多，
小小兔给桃树施肥少。
page_text_en:
At night, Big Bear and Little Rabbit sit together to count the stars.
Sometimes, there are many stars—one star, two stars, three stars... Big Bear and Little Rabbit can't count them all.
Sometimes, there are very few stars, so few that only one bright North Star remains. Big Bear and Little Rabbit can count them all at once.
They heard peaches are delicious, so Big Bear planted nine peach trees in front of his door, and Little Rabbit planted two peach trees in front of his door.
Big Bear planted more peach trees, and Little Rabbit planted fewer.
Big Bear watered the trees more, and Little Rabbit watered them less.
Big Bear fertilized the trees more, and Little Rabbit fertilized them less.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了大大熊和小小兔在夜晚一起数星星的场景，以及他们在门前种桃树并进行浇水、施肥的对比，通过这些日常活动进一步展现‘多少’的主题。

title_zh: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔
title_en: Big Bear and Little Rabbit: Learning Sizes and Thickness
source_file: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
春天，大大熊的桃树开花多，
小小兔的桃树开花少。
大大熊的桃树上有数不清的
蜜蜂来采蜜，小小兔的桃树只吸
引了五只蜜蜂来采蜜。

大大熊的桃树上蜜蜂多，小小兔
的桃树上蜜蜂少。
大大熊的桃树结的桃子大大的，
小小兔的桃树结的桃子小小的。

桃子成熟了，大大熊收获了九筐桃子，小小兔只采收了
一篮子桃子。
大大熊的桃子多，小小兔的桃子少。
大大熊送给刺猬奶奶一大筐桃子，小小兔送给刺猬奶奶
六个桃子。
大大熊送出的桃子多，小小兔送出的桃子少。
这都是因为小小兔给桃树浇水少、施肥少，明年他一定
要给桃树多浇水、多施肥。这样，到了明年，他的桃树也会
开好多花，结出好多大大的桃子。
page_text_en:
Spring has come. Big Bear's peach tree has many blossoms, while Little Rabbit's peach tree has few.
Big Bear's tree attracts countless bees to collect honey, while Little Rabbit's tree only attracts five bees.

Big Bear's tree has many bees, while Little Rabbit's tree has few.
Big Bear's tree bears big, big peaches, while Little Rabbit's tree bears small, small peaches.

When the peaches ripen, Big Bear harvests nine baskets of peaches, while Little Rabbit only gathers one basket.
Big Bear has many peaches, while Little Rabbit has few.
Big Bear gives Grandma Hedgehog a big basket of peaches, while Little Rabbit gives her six peaches.
Big Bear gives away many peaches, while Little Rabbit gives away few.
This is because Little Rabbit waters and fertilizes his tree too little. Next year, he must water and fertilize it more. This way, next year, his tree will bloom with many flowers and bear many big, big peaches.
summary_zh: 本页通过春天桃树开花、蜜蜂采蜜、桃子成熟收获及赠送等场景，对比了大大熊和小小兔在桃树开花多少、蜜蜂数量、桃子大小和数量上的差异，并指出小小兔因浇水施肥少导致收成少，需改进以获得更好的收成，进一步深化了‘多少’和‘大小’的主题。

page_text_ocr_zh:
大大熊吃不了那么多桃子，他要把桃子卖给开
水果加工厂的猩猩老板。
猩猩老板这两天就会派人来把桃子拉走。
哎呀，怎么发生怪事了！大大熊和小小兔去了
一趟集市，回来以后就发现桃子少了一筐。
是谁来过了？
大大熊睡了个午觉，桃子又少了一筐。
到底是谁干的？
一定是小偷！除了小偷，还会有谁呢？
一定要把这个家伙找出来，偷人家的东西，真
是太可耻了。
大大熊拿了一根粗粗的棍子——用来吓唬小偷。
小小兔拿了一根细细的棍子——呵呵，也是用来
吓唬小偷。
page_text_en:
Big Bear can't eat all those peaches, so he wants to sell them to Mr. Gorilla, who runs the fruit juice factory.
Mr. Gorilla will send someone to pick up the peaches in a couple of days.
Oh no, something strange has happened! Big Bear and Little Rabbit went to the market, and when they came back, they found one basket of peaches was missing.
Who could have done this?
Big Bear took a nap, and another basket of peaches was gone.
Who could have done it?
It must be a thief! Who else could it be?
We must find this person and catch them. Stealing from others is truly shameful.
Big Bear grabbed a thick stick — to scare away the thief.
Little Rabbit grabbed a thin stick — hee hee, also to scare away the thief.
summary_zh: 大大熊发现桃子接连减少，怀疑有小偷，于是和小小兔各自准备了粗细不同的棍子准备吓唬小偷，画面展现了他们对桃子被盗的担忧和应对措施。

title_zh: 了解大小多少 粗细：大大熊和小小兔

page_text_ocr_zh:
他们躲在一个柜子里，静静地等待着。
柜子里太挤了，小小兔只好把细细的腿放在大大熊粗粗的腿上面，这样就舒服多了。
等着等着，大大熊和小小兔竟然睡着了。大大熊粗粗的棍子掉到了柜子外，小小兔细细的棍子也掉到了柜子外。

等他们醒来，桃子又少了一筐。
“真是太过分了！”大大熊很生气，拿起大大的杯子喝了一大杯水。
“没错，真是太过分了！”小小兔也非常生气，拿起小小的杯子喝了一小杯水。
page_text_en:
They hid in a cupboard, waiting quietly.
The cupboard was too cramped, so Little Rabbit had to put her thin legs on Big Bear's thick legs, which made her much more comfortable.
Waiting and waiting, Big Bear and Little Rabbit fell asleep. Big Bear's thick stick fell out of the cupboard, and Little Rabbit's thin stick fell out too.

When they woke up, another basket of peaches was missing.
"This is too much!" Big Bear got very angry and took his big cup to drink a big cup of water.
"Right, this is too much!" Little Rabbit was also very angry and took her small cup to drink a small cup of water.
summary_zh: 大大熊和小小兔为防小偷躲进柜子，因太挤而睡着，醒来后发现桃子又少了一筐，两人各自生气地喝了一杯水。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小偷可能还会再来的。大大熊躲到了桌子下面，小小兔躲到了窗帘后面，静静地等待着。
咚，咚，咚——
来了，来了。
大大熊看到了一条粗粗的尾巴。
小小兔看到了一条细细的尾巴。
“又没人在家。”
“我们还是把桃子先抬走吧。”
吼——
大大熊举着桌子站了起来！嗬，是浣熊和猴子
呀，这次一定要把他们送去警察局。
“大熊，我急着要用桃子，来了两次你都不在家，只好把桃子先拿走了。”猩猩老板走了进来，
他惊讶地看着大大熊，“你举着桌子干什么？”
page_text_en:
The thief might come back. Big Bear hid under the table, and Little Rabbit hid behind the curtain, waiting quietly.
Dong, dong, dong—
Here they come, here they come.
Big Bear saw a thick, thick tail.
Little Rabbit saw a thin, thin tail.
"No one's home again."
"Let's take the peaches away first."
Roar—
Big Bear stood up holding the table! Hey, it's the raccoon and the monkey.
Oh, this time I must send them to the police station.
"Bear, I need the peaches urgently. I've come twice and you weren't home, so I had to take them first." The gorilla boss walked in,
looking surprised at Big Bear, "What are you doing holding up the table?"
summary_zh: 大大熊和小小兔为防小偷躲藏在桌下和窗帘后，发现浣熊和猴子偷桃，正欲追赶时，猩猩老板出现，误以为他们举桌抓贼，解释自己因急用而取走桃子。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“大熊想请你们喝茶。”
小小兔端着托盘走了过来，托盘上放着三个小茶杯。
“是是是……请喝茶！”大大熊把桌子放下来。
猩猩老板没时间喝茶，他把买桃子的钱放在桌子上
就走了。

呼——
大大熊大大的手握住小小兔
小小的手，刚才幸好有小小兔，
要不真是糗大了。
page_text_en:
"Big Bear wants to invite you all for tea."
Little Rabbit brought over a tray with three small teacups.
"Yes, yes, yes... please have tea!" Big Bear put the table down.
Gorilla Boss didn't have time for tea; he left the money for the peaches on the table and walked away.

Huff——
Big Bear's big hand held Little Rabbit's
small hand. Just now, it was lucky to have Little Rabbit,
or it would have been really embarrassing.
summary_zh: 大大熊请小小兔和猩猩老板喝茶，猩猩老板因急事未饮便离开，大大熊与小小兔在互动中感到安心，画面展现他们手牵手的温馨场景。

大大熊和小小兔想要锻炼身体，他们去商店里各买了一个呼啦圈，请找到合适的呼啦圈贴纸，贴到他们的旁边吧。
大大熊想帮助小小兔造新房子，说说看，要用哪堆木材才能让房子更坚固呢？请找到木材贴纸帮助小小兔搭房子，并说一说哪堆木材多，哪堆木材少？
page_text_en:
Big Bear and Little Rabbit want to exercise. They each bought a hula hoop at the store. Please find the matching hula hoop sticker and stick it next to them.
Big Bear wants to help Little Rabbit build a new house. Think about it— which pile of wood should be used to make the house more sturdy? Please find the wood stickers to help Little Rabbit build the house, and say which pile has more wood and which has less.
summary_zh: 本页展示了大大熊和小小兔在商店购买呼啦圈锻炼身体，以及大大熊帮助小小兔建造新房子，通过选择木材和比较木材数量，继续深化‘多少’和‘大小’的主题。
